description: Written road rules tests is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Daily number of passed, failed and total general written road rules tests throughout Queensland. Please note: Test Type field in this dataset has been changed from “WRITTEN TEST GENERAL” to “DRIVER PRE LEARNER KNOWLEDGE”. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are driver, licence, rule, test, written test. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
